note: Source registry, not proof of downloaded data or trained models. Each hazard needs local labels, non-event/background examples, predictors aligned to prediction time, and held-out evaluation before a model can be considered trained.

hazards.label: Earthquake shaking impact
hazards.candidate_target: observed event magnitude or observed impact class
hazards.limitation: An event catalogue alone cannot predict earthquake occurrence; use for event catalogue analysis or impact modelling only with appropriate labels and exposure/shaking features.

hazards.label: Tropical cyclone
hazards.candidate_target: track/intensity at a defined forecast lead time
hazards.limitation: Track data alone is not a validated local landfall forecast; split by storm/season and use forecast-time predictors only.

hazards.label: Landslide susceptibility
hazards.source: NASA Global Landslide Catalog / USGS inventories
hazards.candidate_target: inventory presence with defensible background samples
hazards.limitation: Event-only inventories are biased by reporting and do not by themselves provide negatives.

hazards.label: Drought conditions
hazards.source: NASA Earth observation and climate data
hazards.candidate_target: future drought index class at a defined lead time
hazards.limitation: Requires a defined drought index, temporal coverage, and leakage-safe time split.

hazards.label: Extreme heat
hazards.candidate_target: heatwave threshold exceedance at a defined lead time
hazards.limitation: Threshold and local calibration must be specified; historical temperatures alone do not prove health impact.

hazards.label: Wildfire occurrence / burned area
hazards.source: NASA FIRMS and MODIS/VIIRS burned-area products
hazards.candidate_target: fire occurrence or burned-area class with non-fire samples
hazards.limitation: Satellite detections have coverage/cloud/overpass biases and need exposure and weather predictors.

hazards.label: Tsunami coastal exposure
hazards.candidate_target: event impact or scenario exposure, not short-term occurrence
hazards.limitation: Rare-event catalogues are not sufficient for reliable local probability prediction.

hazards.label: Severe storm / extreme rainfall
hazards.source: IMD and Copernicus Climate Data Store
hazards.candidate_target: defined threshold exceedance at a future lead time
hazards.limitation: Needs time-aligned predictors and event/non-event periods; no mixing observed future values into features.

hazards.label: Air-quality episode
hazards.candidate_target: AQI category or pollutant threshold at a future lead time
hazards.limitation: Station observations do not identify a responsible factory; source attribution needs emissions/dispersion evidence.
